title: NeuroFlow Extension: neuroflow/mcp
description: Schema for the neuroflow/mcp extension namespace (RFC 0009). Per-document metadata controlling how a tool or workflow is exposed through a NeuroFlow MCP server. Every field is optional; a document without this block is exposed using the RFC 0009 defaults. This is a runtime extension contract, not part of the portable NeuroFlow core.

expose.description: Expose this document as an MCP tool. Defaults to true, except for uiApp tools without an app block, which default to false.

name.description: Override for the MCP tool name derived from the document id. Names beginning with neuroflow_ are reserved for the fixed binding tools.

title.description: Human-readable MCP tool title. Falls back to niivue/ui block.label, then the document id.

maxWaitMs.description: How long a call without the tasks extension waits before returning a runId handle. Server default is 30000.

valueTypes.description: Extension types this tool passes inline as JSON values rather than as artifact references (RFC 0009 section 1.3).

appDef.description: MCP App declaration (RFC 0009 section 6). The server exposes the tool with _meta.ui.resourceUri and serves the bundle as a text/html;profile=mcp-app resource.

resourceUri.description: ui:// URI of the app's HTML resource.

connectDomains.description: Origins the app may fetch from (CSP connect-src), e.g. the runtime's loopback artifact endpoint.

resourceDomains.description: Origins the app may load scripts, styles, images, and fonts from.

requiredOutputs.description: Tool outputs the app must submit before the step can complete. Each MUST name a declared output of the tool.
